title: Adulterine
summary: ADUL'TERINE, adjective Proceeding from adulterous commerce; spurious. ADUL'TERINE, noun In the civil law, a child issuing from an adulterous connection.

inlines.v: ADUL'TERINE, adjective Proceeding from adulterous commerce; spurious. ADUL'TERINE, noun In the civil law, a child issuing from an adulterous connection.
